sasha: Quick note — found a perf knee when we let max_tokens_per_batch=65536 on A10 with mixed L4 loads; canary showed ~12% tail p95 increase. attaching quick log.

matt: ugh, details? was that kv fragmentation or kernel selection fallback?

sasha: Kernel fallback. Profiling shows kernel_selector chose generic matmul at seq=1024 instead of fused-opt at seq=512; kv cache fragmentation caused page-aligned padding increases.

kai: do you have the perf counters? latency breakdown?

sasha: pasted below:

``
GPU A10 | seq=512 => avg 6.2ms/token | seq=1024 => avg 7.8ms/token
Kernel chosen: fused_gemm_v3 (512) vs generic_gemm (1024)
KV mem overhead: +18% for certain pack patterns
Queue wait time spiked by +4ms at p95
``

olivia: sounds like our soft-cap + spill policy would help: allow batches to exceed soft_max_tokens by up to 20% but spill oldest requests to the next slice so kernels keep a predictable shape.

matt: propose experiment matrix:
- soft_cap = 0.8 * hw_cap, spill = true
- soft_cap = 1.0 * hw_cap, spill = false (baseline)
- per-card soft multiplier: A10=0.9, T4=0.7, L4=0.95, A100=1.05, H100=1.0

kai: also include variant with kernel-selection hinting: if seq distribution mean > 600 prefer fused_gemm_v3 via hint to kernel_selector.

sasha: I ran a quick sim with `./tools/batch_sim --card A10 --soft 0.9 --spill` — p95 improved ~6% vs baseline, throughput +-1%.

terra-bot: deploy-benchmark: canary build 2026-03-16-rc7 ran 2h, results uploaded to /bench/canary/2623456789

olivia: action items:
1) eng-runtime: add per-card soft_cap table + spill flag (matt)
2) infra: add canary to run mixed L4 workload for 3h overnight (kai)
3) perf: rerun kernel-selector heuristics with training set (sasha)

matt: i'll open a PR for config and add the experiment YAML. will ping when ready :+1:

sasha: thanks — will attach perf counters and a short reproducer in that PR.

kai: noted, will schedule infra run. if anyone wants to join troubleshooting tomorrow ping me.

olivia: :eyes: good plan. let's keep max_tokens_per_batch conservative for Dedicated until we validate.
